title: Driving Video Retrieval for Complex Queries with Structured Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2606.09109v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video retrieval at scale is central to data curation and safety validation in autonomous driving, where users want to find not only scenes but also dynamic events such as cut-ins and hard braking. Existing vision-language and keyword-based retrieval methods often miss these events because the relevant motion may not be explicitly described in text or captured by lexical overlap. Rule-based retrieval can encode such events more directly, but it is brittle: generated or hand-written rules often fail when their assumptions do not match real driving data. We propose STRIVE-D, a data-calibrated retrieval framework for driving videos. It uses weakly labeled in-domain videos to estimate when a query rule is reliable, adapt rules that mismatch observed data, and fuse calibrated rule scores with vision-language and keyword-based retrieval signals. translated_title: 基于结构化定位的驾驶视频复杂查询检索
translated_abstract: 大规模视频检索是自动驾驶数据整理与安全验证的核心任务，用户不仅希望检索到场景，还希望找到诸如加塞、急刹车等动态事件。现有的视觉-语言检索与基于关键词的检索方法常常会遗漏这些事件，原因在于相关运动可能未在文本中被明确描述，或无法通过词汇重叠被捕获。基于规则的检索能够更直接地编码这类事件，但它较为脆弱：当生成或手写的规则与真实驾驶数据的假设不匹配时往往会失效。我们提出了STRIVE-D，一个面向驾驶视频的数据校准检索框架。该框架利用弱标注的域内视频来估计查询规则何时可靠，对与观测数据不匹配的规则进行自适应调整，并将校准后的规则分数与视觉-语言检索及关键词检索信号相融合。在三个驾驶基准上的实验（包括新发布的Dr...（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出STRIVE-D数据校准检索框架，通过弱标注视频评估并自适应调整查询规则，将校准后的规则分数与视觉-语言及关键词检索信号融合，从而在驾驶视频中可靠检索加塞、急刹等复杂动态事件。
en_tdlr: STRIVE-D is a data-calibrated retrieval framework that uses weakly labeled in-domain videos to estimate rule reliability, adapt mismatched rules, and fuse calibrated rule scores with vision-language and keyword signals for reliable retrieval of dynamic driving events like cut-ins and hard braking.
